metadata.description: Comprehensive drug reference database for IatrogeniX safety validator. Sourced from Oxford Handbook of Clinical Medicine (10th Ed), Oxford Handbook of Critical Care (4th Ed), and BNF. 100 drugs per subspecialty.

drugs.name: Sacubitril/Valsartan
drugs.black_box: Angioedema, do not combine with ACEi

drugs.name: Alteplase (tPA)
drugs.dose: 0.9mg/kg IV (max 90mg) in stroke; 100mg over 2hr in PE

drugs.name: Formoterol
drugs.black_box: Monotherapy without ICS in asthma CI

drugs.name: Beclomethasone (ICS)
drugs.black_box: Adrenal suppression at high doses, growth in children

drugs.name: Theophylline
drugs.black_box: Narrow therapeutic index; arrhythmia, seizures at toxicity

drugs.name: Oxygen
drugs.black_box: Hypercapnia in type-2 RF if uncontrolled

drugs.name: Nitric Oxide (inhaled)
drugs.indication: ARDS refractory hypoxia, PAH, persistent pulmonary HTN newborn

drugs.name: Voriconazole
drugs.dose: 6mg/kg BD load, 4mg/kg BD IV; 200-300mg BD PO

drugs.name: Rituximab
drugs.dose: 375mg/m² IV Q4W x4; or 1000mg Q2W x2
drugs.black_box: PML (JC virus), infusion reactions, HBV reactivation

drugs.name: Acetazolamide
drugs.indication: Altitude sickness, central sleep apnoea, metabolic alkalosis
